title: Puzzle3d Engagement Zoom To Selection
description: Add engagement Zoom option in puzzle3d that zooms/framed camera to the current selection when pressed or submitted via command line.
summary:
Added puzzle3d engagement Zoom that frames the orbit camera on the current selection.

- Engagement panel shows a Zoom option when any object, vortex, or attraction is selected; command line accepts "zoom".
- requestPuzzle3dZoomToSelection + SelectionZoom viewport hook apply applyAutoFitCamera via boundsFromPuzzle3dSelection (objects, vortices, attractions).
- Play controller and playground publisher wire option press and submit.

226 @semio-tech/puzzle-3d-react tests pass; 30 @semio-tech/puzzle-3d-play tests pass.
